name: Google Skills
tagline: Official Agent Skills for Google products and Google Cloud
description: google/skills is the official Agent Skills repository from Google, packaging skills for Google products and Google Cloud services into the emerging Agent Skills standard. Installation is a single command — npx skills add google/skills — and the collection sits at the center of the Agent Skills ecosystem that exploded this week, giving agents structured, versionable skill definitions rather than ad-hoc prompts.
highlights: Official Agent Skills from Google for its products and Google Cloud
Install via a single command: npx skills add google/skills
Part of the emerging Agent Skills standard ecosystem
Structured, versionable skill definitions instead of ad-hoc prompts
curatorNote: When Google ships official skills, the Agent Skills standard has arrived. The install-once model for vendor skill packs is the strongest signal yet that SKILL.md is becoming the distribution format for agent knowledge.
